name: build
description: The build pipeline: test-writer -> dev -> publish (the architect/PLAN.md stage is GONE — req-test works from the request directly). req-test (reasoning OFF) writes the FAILING tests from the request; req-dev (reasoning ON) reasons the implementation to green. Works GREENFIELD or on an EXISTING branch: a forge git CLONE brings the repo into the shared volume; with `ref` set the pipeline extends/fixes that branch (test author adds RED tests, dev makes them pass) and publish pushes the new commits back onto `ref` so the PR updates in place; with `ref` empty it builds greenfield and publish opens a git-factory PR to dev. Gates live in the roles (req-test OwnCheck = RED, req-dev check = green). Scanning + review are the pr-review workflow's job. Inputs {task, namespace, repo, ref?}.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: the work to build, or the issues to fix

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: an existing branch to extend/fix and push back to (a PR branch); empty = greenfield + open a new dev PR

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: the project every resource this run creates (the repo, its PR) is tagged with, and the project whose PM tickets + wiki the build agents read; defaults to ops

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; REF='${inputs.ref}'; PROJ='${inputs.project}'; [ -z "$PROJ" ] && PROJ=ops; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; if [ -n "$REF" ]; then git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "$REF"; echo "working on existing branch $REF:"; git log --oneline -1; else CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/r -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"name\":\"$REPO\",\"visibility\":\"private\",\"project\":\"$PROJ\"}"); case "$CODE" in 201|409) ;; *) echo "repo create failed $CODE"; cat /tmp/r; exit 1;; esac; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" main >/dev/null 2>&1; then D=$(mktemp -d); git -C "$D" init -q; git -C "$D" -c user.email=blacksmith@codearmory -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q --allow-empty -m 'chore: init main'; git -C "$D" push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/main; fi; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q main; echo 'cloned:'; git log --oneline -1; fi

with.task: Package this project into a container image: write a production multi-stage Dockerfile and a .dockerignore grounded in the code (go.mod, the main package, the port it serves). Do not change application code.

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; CHANGED=0; for f in Dockerfile web/Dockerfile frontend/Dockerfile; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; if grep -q 'npm ci' "$f"; then sed -i 's/npm ci/npm install/g' "$f"; echo "normalized npm ci -> npm install in $f"; CHANGED=1; fi; done; if [ "$CHANGED" = 1 ]; then git config user.email 'pipeline@codearmory.local'; git config user.name 'codearmory-pipeline'; git add -A; git commit -m 'chore(build): use npm install so image build does not require a lockfile' || true; fi; echo normalize-done

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod && cd /workspace && echo '=== TREE ===' && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort && echo '=== go test ===' && (go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20)

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; REF='${inputs.ref}'; if [ -n "$REF" ]; then BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/$REF"); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no new commits -- nothing to push'; exit 0; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$REF; echo "pushed the change to $REF"; exit 0; fi; BASE=$(git rev-parse origin/main); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no commits from the stages -- nothing to publish'; exit 0; fi; TYPES=$(git log "$BASE"..HEAD --format=%s | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+)(\(.*\))?!?:.*/\1/' | sort -u); TYPE=chore; for t in feat fix perf refactor docs test build ci chore style revert; do if printf '%s\n' "$TYPES" | grep -qx "$t"; then TYPE=$t; break; fi; done; git fetch -q --tags "$GIT_URL" 2>/dev/null || true; LT=$(git tag -l 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' | sed -E 's/^(v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -V | tail -1); [ -n "$LT" ] || LT=v0.0.0; MA=$(echo "$LT" | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$/\1/'); MI=$(echo "$LT" | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$/\2/'); PA=$(echo "$LT" | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$/\3/'); S=$(git log "$BASE"..HEAD --format='%s%n%b'); if printf '%s' "$S" | grep -qE '^[a-z]+(\(.+\))?!:|BREAKING CHANGE'; then MA=$((MA+1)); MI=0; PA=0; elif printf '%s' "$S" | grep -qE '^feat(\(.+\))?:'; then MI=$((MI+1)); PA=0; else PA=$((PA+1)); fi; VS="v${MA}.${MI}.${PA}"; SLUG=$(printf '%s' "${inputs.task}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -cs 'a-z0-9' '-' | sed -E 's/^-+//; s/-+$//' | cut -c1-40 | sed -E 's/-+$//'); [ -z "$SLUG" ] && SLUG=change; BR=$TYPE/${SLUG}; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then git push "$GIT_URL" "$BASE":refs/heads/dev; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$BR; RID=$(curl -s "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1); PR=$(curl -s -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":\"$VS $TYPE: ${inputs.task}\",\"source_ref\":\"$BR\",\"target_ref\":\"dev\"}"); echo "$PR"; echo PR_OPENED
